learningObjectives: Explain the physiological or methodological basis of Normal EEG Variants.
Apply Normal EEG Variants to technically valid clinical interpretation.
Identify artifacts, confounds and limits that could alter conclusions.
Communicate findings without exceeding the evidence or professional scope.

mechanismMap.label: Core concept
mechanismMap.detail: Wicket waves, small sharp spikes, rhythmic mid-temporal theta, lambda waves and other variants can mimic epileptiform discharges.

mechanismMap.label: Mechanism
mechanismMap.detail: Recognition depends on morphology, distribution, state and lack of aftergoing slow wave or background disruption.

mechanismMap.label: Clinical integration
mechanismMap.detail: Prevents false epilepsy diagnosis and unnecessary medication.

mechanismMap.label: Boundary condition
mechanismMap.detail: A single sharply contoured waveform is not automatically a spike.
